description: Duty/rest limit engine for Part 135 crew and dispatch. Grounds in 14 CFR §135.273 (unscheduled ops) and §135.271 (HEMS/helicopter). Composed into av-dispatch-001 and av-copilot-001 for any crew legality determination.

source_regulations.title: Duty period limitations and rest requirements (unscheduled ops)
Helicopter hospital emergency medical evacuation service (HEMES)
Flight time limitations — scheduled operations (reference only)

unscheduled_135.description: Unscheduled Part 135 — air medical (fixed-wing), charter, on-demand. Applies to Life Flight Network Hawaii PC-12 operations.

rest_requirements.note: Rest period must be free from all duty. On-call is NOT qualifying rest unless crew is given a rest facility and is not disturbed.

duty_period_limits.note: §135.273 does not set an explicit max duty period for unscheduled ops — company GOM governs. Apply GOM if stricter. Common standard: 14 hours max duty.

hemes.description: Helicopter EMS — §135.271 applies. NOT applicable to fixed-wing air medical. Misconfiguring a PC-12 operation as HEMES applies wrong rest floor.
hemes.validation: Only valid when tenant.aircraftCategory = helicopter. Flag as configuration error if applied to fixed-wing.

computation_rules.label: require_actual_records
computation_rules.logic: Duty limit computation requires actual duty period start time, previous rest hours, and accumulated flight hours. A proposed schedule is NOT verification. If any of these inputs are missing, duty status = UNVERIFIED and release = BLOCKED.

computation_rules.label: compute_remaining_duty
computation_rules.logic: remaining_duty_hrs = gom_max_duty_hrs - (now_utc - duty_period_start_utc). If remaining_duty_hrs < estimated_flight_time + turnaround + post_flight: status = RED (cannot complete trip within duty limits).
computation_rules.surface_as: YELLOW if remaining < 2h beyond trip, RED if remaining < trip ETE

computation_rules.label: verify_rest_qualification
computation_rules.logic: rest_hours_since_last_duty must be >= 8 hours of qualifying rest (free from duty). If rest_hours < 8: status = RED — crew is not legal to begin a new duty period.
computation_rules.on_fail: block_release — crew does not meet minimum rest requirement per §135.273

computation_rules.label: flight_time_24h_limit
computation_rules.logic: flight_hours_last_24h + proposed_trip_ete must not exceed 8 hours (or 10 if augmented crew is verified). If limit would be exceeded: status = RED.
computation_rules.on_fail: block_release — flight time limit would be exceeded per §135.273

computation_rules.label: quarterly_annual_limits
computation_rules.logic: Compute projected totals: quarterly = flight_hours_current_quarter + proposed_ete; annual = flight_hours_calendar_year + proposed_ete. Surface YELLOW if > 90% of limit. Surface RED if limit would be exceeded.

computation_rules.label: currency_items_check
computation_rules.logic: Verify: medical certificate valid and class appropriate for operation; flight review within 24 calendar months (Part 91) or line check within applicable 135 window; instrument currency if IFR (6 approaches + holds within 6 calendar months); landing currency (3 takeoffs/landings within 90 days for day VFR pax; night currency if applicable). Each item must be confirmed from logbook records, not assumed.
computation_rules.on_fail: block_release — list each expired or unverifiable item

output_schema.blocking_items: array of RED or UNVERIFIED items that prevent release

hard_stops.label: unverified_equals_blocked
hard_stops.logic: UNVERIFIED crew legality is not a CONDITIONAL release — it is BLOCKED. A dispatcher cannot release a flight when crew duty/rest records are unavailable. The absence of information is not permission to proceed.
hard_stops.on_fail: block_release — state exactly which records are missing

hard_stops.label: no_hemes_for_fixed_wing
hard_stops.logic: If operation type is air medical but aircraft is fixed-wing (PC-12, B200, Caravan), apply §135.273, NOT §135.271 (HEMES). Flag as configuration error if HEMES is applied to a fixed-wing operator.
